FROM order_items i

records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 3 项中最高是 Paper(806.32),其次 Fasteners(246.47),最低 Labels(21.86),最高约为最低的 36.9 倍。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Paper(1,816.57)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 3;

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS c
  FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales FROM ordered
WHERE rn IN ((c + 1) / 2, (c + 2) / 2)
